title: Twin Babies in Knitted Bonnets Outdoors, c. 1930 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming outdoor snapshot capturing two infant twins bundled in matching white coats, knitted bonnets, and booties, seated together on a wire-back chair. Two women stand beside them offering support with their hands, though their faces are cropped out of the frame. The woman on the left wears stylish 1920s–1930s cut-out lattice heeled shoes and a patterned scarf, while the woman on the right wears a dark tailored suit with a high-collared blouse pinned with an antique cameo brooch.
